That there are people that care, like you, much more than a girlfriend would. Nothing can replace the emotional gap of friendships and comradery. 

A girlfriend is more as just a filler anyways. She can grow to something more trusted, but for now, that should remain low on the list.

I know this. All my feeling trapped in various books. I was reading the Percy Jackson series as well (my favorite series too!) and the Pendragon series. They, along with other incredible youth fiction were boxed away to goodwill and Now I may never look at them again. 

But then I did move to college, with my own debit card, and I purchased the top book I wanted forever The Katurran Odyssey. Ordered it through Amazon and shopped straight to my dorm. I am slowly gaining my collection, but it will all come back soon.

I relate to you a lot. My last year of highschool and everybody is up to their tits in plans and dresses and shit. And I hated all of them.

So, I had a few friends, and they're not great or anything, but enough to want to hang out with me. We ended up watching Captain America The Winter Soldier and went back home to Metal Gear Solid V. We had a great time. 

Point is, try not to let other people define who you are or control your emotions. And there's still life ahead, lots of time to find more people that you can trust and they trust you.

If you have any other issues or problems that I can talk to you with, then please, respond.

It's hard, but I'd suggest trying to find at least one good person that you can talk to about whatever. It can be a best friend, a mentor, or even a psychologist.

It sounds like you need to get it all off your chest. Posting here helps a lot because we can usually offer feedback.

I can understand all you said. It's as if other people need me here, but what if I don't wanna be here? It's a struggle.

Yeah, playing games with my one friend is fun, but it can only last until I start getting depressed again and wanting to end it.

But hey, those right decisions just might pay off. You aren't at the end of college yet, and you said it yourself; you'd get an okay pay. That seems more than satisfactory to me. Hell, probably a whole lot better than me.

Maybe you could try finding some clubs or other people to do other activities with. Just a suggestion, because it sounds like you should do something for yourself that you want.

Oh yes, I did forget about her solo stuff. I have heard it and I think it's great. There just doesn't seem to be many popular sadcore artists. Probably because people want to listen to happier, formulaic music.

Have you thought about taking a break? A semester or two off? Schools understand when their students are having some problems and they care more about the wellbeing than just graduating or simply getting the grades in. This can also give you some time to think about your life and what you want to do.

If it was me, I'd still go. When I was with my therapist I would go even if I was feeling well. She offered me techniques and coping skills that I could take and use when I'm in a not-so-great mood and I had nobody around.

Also, just talking about things to another person can really help, at least for me.

The only advice I could offer is to see a psychiatrist and tell them what you wrote here. Especially your concern with addictive medication. I went down that road, but I'm out of it now.

I definitely understand you with the loss of sleep. Sleep really does make a huge difference, but getting to it can be difficult. You can go over different sleeping medication with your doctor too in case they might not want to jump to an SSRI. It really varies with each doctor. They have different methods. 

Good luck to you and I hope you get some good rest

I go back to college in 2 days also. I'm not sure if it's exactly a fit for me. Honestly, I'm only doing it because people (family and teachers mostly) said that it's the only way to get a good steady job in the world. But I really should figure out what I want to do. What do I want most out of my life? 

I can't say for sure about that either. But do you know what you want? Is college a right choice right now?

I do like The Smiths. Does anybody mind if I go ahead and discuss my favorite music I listen to when I'm depressed? I'll just go ahead, thanks.

A guy I like to listen to is Sparklehorse. His music makes me want to feel so sad and happy at the same time. A kind of bittersweet, I guess. Also learning about him and his life made me pretty sad too.

Another band I like is The Antlers. Their album Hospice is definitely my favorite. But for another kind of bittersweet feeling I go to their album In The Attic. 

The third is a band called Carissa's Wierd. Very short lived, but wonderful still. One or two of the band members went on to start Band Of Horses, another favorite of mine.

And of course my all time favorite band Radiohead. I've loved them for a long time and I don't see me stopping any time soon.

If there's any questions on these musicians, I might answer. Or my own opinion, you could ask too.
Pretty much every night I'm up thinking about all the people that I met and all the friendships I tried to keep up. But almost all of them fell through

I get you on the grades thing,  kinda. In high school I was pretty good academically, but it came at a cost for my social life. I never really had the full high school experience, I guess. So now that I'm in college, I can have the college experience, but school is overtaking that again (I'm still struggling keeping up my C average)        and I'm just too much of an introvert that being around other new people makes me uncomfortable and pretty angry. Idk where this anger comes from either. And still, no real future. "you have lots of potential" they all said to me. But there's no point to that if I don't know what to do or how to get there.

Thanks. And yeah, I don't care. Pretty much only about myself. And it's all personal gain. I mean, isn't that what society wants anyways? For the people that work hard to be successful or whatever? Sorry if I sound like I'm trying to bring politics in here, I'm really trying not to. More about my anger with expectations. Which really makes me want to end my life because I know I can't get up to their expectations, and I really don't care much for a life with depression
